newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Nationals demand secure land title.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Nationals demand secure land title.

text.p: The junior partner in Australia's coalition government, the Nationals, on Friday urged the government to legislate to guarantee pastoral leases against native land claims.
"If you give somebody land title ... exclusivity to occupy (land), to do their thing, that's what we must uphold," National Party president Don McDonald told reporters.
McDonald said the party would endorse higher taxes to boost a special fund for aboriginals to buy land in lieu of land claims.
The position of pastoral leases was thrown into doubt by a recent High Court ruling that pastoral leases did not automatically over-ride aboriginal land rights.
